name: ccx
description: ccx - claudecodex: continue the same task in Claude Code and Codex. Hand this thread to Claude, or bring a Claude Code session into this thread with its full context. Needs the ccx app on this Mac: github.com/aaronwong1999/ccx

interface.longDescription: Pairs a Claude Code session with a Codex thread so you can keep working on the same task in either app. $to-claude hands this thread to Claude Code; $from-claude brings a Claude Code session, or its new progress, into this thread. Everything runs locally through the ccx app (github.com/aaronwong1999/ccx). Not affiliated with OpenAI or Anthropic.
